limitations: Annual observations use the earliest SEC filing found for each fiscal period; comparative/restated facts are not a complete point-in-time archive.
Entry is the next month-end after filing plus one day. Thresholds use only prior annual observations within each issuer (at least three).
Price-to-cash-flow uses annual weighted average shares, a market-cap proxy; P/E uses positive reported basic annual EPS. Loss years do not get a P/E.
All foreign currency margins use consistent same-filing currency. Valuations require USD metrics; unsupported ADR/currency cases are omitted.
Latest ratios compare September 2026 prices with the latest available annual filing, not a claimed current trailing-twelve-month or forward multiple.
Future gaps are stock minus past-only volatility-targeted gold CAGR. Quarterly trades, financed exposure, fees; realized risk can differ.
Overlapping future outcomes and a surviving-stock sample limit inference. Issuer resampling cannot remove time dependence or selection bias.
High GAAP net margins can reflect impairments, tax items or sale gains; they are not AISC margins. Revenue growth is not mine supply growth.
